metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the `ical` command in [output/](/workspace/output/), with [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) as the Node entry point and usage details in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md).

Verified the parser and expander with `node output/test.js`, syntax checks, and CLI runs. The checks cover recurrence rules, non-Gregorian calendars, timezone transitions, overrides, availability, alarms, and malformed input.

Calendar scales depend on Node’s built-in ICU data. Unsupported scales produce a warning; unresolved timezone identifiers remain floating and are also reported.

tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_exrule_monthly_second_fri0')

    def test_exrule_monthly_second_friday(submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        # Weekly meeting every Friday, but exclude the second Friday of each month.
        body = (
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\n"
            "DTSTART:20260306T100000Z\n"
            "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=FR;COUNT=10\n"
            "EXRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2FR\n"
        )
        out = run_expand(
            submission_command,
            wrap_event(body),
            "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z",
            tmp_path,
        )
        starts = starts_for(out["occurrences"], "e1")
        # March 2026: Fridays are 6, 13, 20, 27. Second Friday is 13.
        # April 2026: Fridays are 3, 10, 17, 24. Second Friday is 10.
        # May 2026: Fridays are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29. Second Friday is 8.
        assert "2026-03-13T10:00:00Z" not in starts
        assert "2026-04-10T10:00:00Z" not in starts
        assert "2026-05-08T10:00:00Z" not in starts

submission_command = ('/usr/bin/node', '/tmp/submission/output/main.js')
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_cancel_status_if_present_0')

    def test_cancel_status_if_present_must_be_cancelled(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 5546 §3.2.5 STATUS row: "MUST be set to CANCELLED to cancel
        the entire event." A CANCEL that carries STATUS with any value
        other than CANCELLED (e.g. TENTATIVE or CONFIRMED) is internally
        inconsistent — the METHOD says "cancel" but the STATUS does not.
        Validator must warn."""
        body = _CANCEL_WITH_ORGANIZER + "ATTENDEE:mailto:jane@example.com\nSTATUS:TENTATIVE\n"
        ics = _wrap_with_method("CANCEL", body)
        out = run_parse(submission_command, ics, tmp_path)
        # Observe the named STATUS rule; an unrelated iTIP warning cannot
        # satisfy this check and hide a missing status diagnostic.
        warnings = cast(list[dict[str, Any]], out.get("warnings") or [])
>       assert any(
            warning.get("kind") == "itip_missing_property"
            and warning.get("method") == "CANCEL"
            and warning.get("component") == "VEVENT"
            and warning.get("property") == "STATUS"
            for warning in warnings
        )
E       assert False
E        +  where False = any(<generator object test_cancel_status_if_present_must_be_cancelled.<locals>.<genexpr> at 0x7fc58bbb3370>)

submission_command = ('/usr/bin/node', '/tmp/submission/output/main.js')
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_rdate_period_invalid_end_0')

    def test_rdate_period_invalid_end_before_start_warns(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """§3.3.9: "The start MUST be before the end." A reversed period is malformed;
        the parser emits `malformed_value` and either drops the entry or preserves
        it untouched, but MUST NOT crash."""
        body = (
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\nDTSTART:20260301T100000Z\n"
            # end < start
            "RDATE;VALUE=PERIOD:20260310T110000Z/20260310T090000Z\n"
            "SUMMARY:ok\n"
        )
        out = run_parse(submission_command, wrap_event(body), tmp_path)
        ev = find_event(out, "e1")
        # Event itself must remain intact.
        assert ev.get("summary") == "ok"
        kinds = [w.get("kind") for w in out.get("warnings", [])]
>       assert "malformed_value" in kinds
E       AssertionError: assert 'malformed_value' in []

editorial.last_message: Claims a Node ical command (output/main.js, README) verified with node output/test.js, syntax checks and CLI runs covering recurrence rules, non-Gregorian calendars, timezone transitions, overrides, availability, alarms and malformed input. Notes calendar scales depend on Node's built-in ICU data (unsupported scales warn) and unresolved TZIDs stay floating with a report. Not a false completion claim.
